# AGENTS.md — 09-esports-club

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this folder.

## Context
- Template: **NOVA E.C.**, esports club, style "Football matchday programme".
- Stack: React 19, Three.js (R3F), Vite. Do not add dependencies unless the user asks.
- The design contract is in `DESIGN.md`. Read it before changing anything visual.

## Files
- `src/content.js` — club, fixtures, table, bracket scores, squad, all copy (EN + RU)
- `src/App.jsx` — page sections and the bracket
- `src/Scene.jsx` — 3D crest (React Three Fiber)
- `src/styles.css` — tokens at the top

## How to run
- `npm install`
- `npm run dev`
- `npm run build   # ./dist`

## Rules
- Content changes go to the content file, not into markup or components.
- Every user-facing string exists in **en** and **ru**. English is the default; `?lang=ru` and the language button switch it.
- Colors, fonts, radii and spacing are tokens. Change tokens, not individual elements.
- Keep the signature block: 3D enamel club crest built from extruded shapes (no model files) + clickable cup bracket.
- Keep accessibility: semantic headings, visible focus, alt text, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
- Keep it static: no backend, no booking or payment flows.
- Three club colours (green, orange, black) on programme paper — never neon, never dark mode.
- Rubik Mono One for club lettering only; PT Sans Narrow for everything else.
- The crest is geometry in Scene.jsx — redraw it with THREE.Shape, keep the enamel-pin materials.
- Tables and brackets look printed: hard borders, tabular numbers.
- Lighting is local (Lightformers); don't add remote HDR files.

## Done means
- The page builds/opens without console errors.
- Both languages render with no missing strings.
- Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px wide.
